# Agent skills

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/skills.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **JFrog CLI 2.128.0**. Registered classes: **local**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/skills/${AW_REPO}/api/v1/skills`

## Before connecting

- Local skills repository.
- review-skill/SKILL.md with YAML front matter name: review-skill, version: 1.0.0, description, followed by skill content.

Authentication: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.

Fresh client state: Use fresh JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR/JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR and an empty install directory under AW_WORK.

## Configure

Runtime-only configuration. Use a shell with tracing disabled; remove AW_WORK after use. No token is part of this recipe source.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR="$AW_WORK/jfrog"
export JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR="$AW_WORK/tmp"
export JFROG_CLI_REPORT_USAGE=false
jf config add aw --url "$AW_URL" --artifactory-url "$AW_URL/artifactory" --access-token "$AW_TOKEN" --interactive=false
```

```sh
export JFROG_SKILLS_DISABLE_QUIET_FAILURE=true
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/install"
```

## Publish

Classes: **local**. Publish uses the indexed skills API. --skip-scan avoids invoking the separately scoped security-scanning service.

```sh
jf agent skills publish review-skill --repo "$AW_REPO" --server-id aw --skip-scan
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local**. Resolve an exact version into the selected directory.

```sh
jf agent skills list --repo "$AW_REPO" --server-id aw
jf agent skills install review-skill --repo "$AW_REPO" --version 1.0.0 --path "$AW_WORK/install" --server-id aw
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Only local repositories are registered. This recipe does not claim malware or policy scanning.
